hero.title: Full-Stack Developer
hero.description: I build full-stack web applications from idea to production using Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. Experienced in REST APIs, AI integrations, and modern deployment pipelines.

about.label: About
about.title: Who am I and what do I do?
about.p1: I'm a Computer Engineering graduate from Karabük University. Alongside my undergraduate studies, I participated in an exchange program at Vilnius Gediminas Technical University in Lithuania.
about.p2: I gained hands-on full-stack development experience through internships and TÜBİTAK-supported projects. I build web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and Spring Boot — handling REST APIs, authentication, AI integrations, database design, and deployment.
about.p3: Since May 2025, I've been working as an independent full-stack developer, building and shipping my own products (Birik, MAKAS, Tribun) and managing production environments with Docker, Vercel, and Railway.

items: Developed and shipped responsive React.js UIs with Redux and Redux Toolkit for predictable state management in complex workflows.
Designed a reusable, accessible UI component library that became the foundation of the team's shared design system.
Implemented comprehensive i18n support enabling the product to serve multilingual audiences.
Worked in two-week agile sprints — participating in stand-ups, code reviews, and sprint planning with senior engineers.
Contributed to a blockchain-integrated web application, responsible for frontend-backend integration between React.js UIs and a Firebase-based crypto payment system.
Resolved integration issues between client-side state and async blockchain transaction flows, improving payment pipeline reliability.
Building, shipping, and maintaining full-stack web and mobile applications from idea to production.
Developing modern web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
Managing REST APIs, authentication, AI integrations, database design, and deployment pipelines.
Deploying and maintaining applications with Docker, Vercel, and Railway.
Building and maintaining Birik (Personal Finance), MAKAS (Barbershop Management SaaS), and Tribun (Football Prediction) products.

items.name: MAKAS
items.description: A comprehensive barbershop appointment and salon management SaaS platform that can independently scale across multiple salons. Features role-based auth (owner, staff, customer), Cloudinary media management, and Prisma ORM.

items.name: Birik
items.description: A production full-stack personal finance app covering income/expense tracking, budgets, subscriptions, savings goals, and recurring transactions. Features AI-powered bank statement import via Anthropic API (Claude Haiku), JWT auth, and multi-currency support with live exchange rates.

items.name: Akinel Oto Yedek Parça
items.description: A corporate website built for a client in the automotive spare parts industry. Modern, mobile-friendly design featuring a product catalog, contact information, and brand identity presentation.

items.name: Tribün
items.description: A social prediction game platform where users create private leagues, predict match scores, and compete on a live leaderboard. Launched with the 2026 FIFA World Cup as its first season, designed to support future seasons and tournaments.

items.name: Birik Mobile
items.description: A cross-platform mobile app for Birik personal finance, built with React Native and Expo targeting iOS and Android from a single codebase. Consumes the existing Birik REST API while adapting UI/UX patterns for native mobile interactions.

items.name: LstmCryptoBot
items.description: An AI-based cryptocurrency trading bot built with Python and LSTM neural networks. Time-series analysis on Bitcoin price data, models trained with TensorFlow/Keras, strategy backtesting with Backtrader, and fully containerized with Docker.

items.name: Kadın Emeği
items.description: A TÜBİTAK-supported second-hand marketplace application. Built RESTful backend services with Spring Boot and delivered React.js frontend features in parallel for a platform serving real end-users.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's Work Together
